2608.25904.title: One Form to Transfer Them All: Pretraining Multilingual Language Models Beyond Native Orthography
2608.25904.paper_summary: Multilingual language models transfer knowledge across languages through shared subword vocabulary, a mechanism that breaks down when related languages use different writing systems. Prior work addresses this via script equalization (romanization or IPA transcription), but direct comparisons are rare; the focus has been on encoder-only models, with most work adapting existing pretrained models. We systematically compare different input representations in autoregressive multilingual pretraining, comparing orthographic text, IPA, and romanization in a controlled setup across three scales (467M, 709M, and 1.03B) on eight languages in four typologically motivated pairs. Across a wide range of downstream tasks on seen and unseen languages, romanized pretraining yields the strongest cross-lingual transfer, and the advantage over text widens with scale. IPA improves over text in most settings but trails romanization. Surprisingly, finetuning a text-pretrained model on romanized data hurts performance on languages already covered by the base model, only marginally helping when the model lacks script coverage. Our results indicate that for multilingual models spanning typologically diverse scripts, to obtain maximum benefits, romanization should be treated as a core design choice applied at pretraining rather than a post hoc fix.
2608.25904.paper_summary_zh: 多語言模型通過共享的子詞詞彙在語言之間轉移知識，這一機制在相關語言使用不同書寫系統時會失效。先前的研究通過腳本均衡（羅馬化或IPA音標轉錄）來解決這一問題，但直接比較的研究很少；重點主要放在僅使用編碼器的模型上，大多數工作都是在適應現有的預訓練模型。我們系統地比較了自回歸多語言預訓練中不同的輸入表示，並在四個具有類型學動機的配對中，對八種語言的正字法文本、IPA和羅馬化進行了控制設置下的比較，規模為467M、709M和1.03B。在一系列下游任務中，對於已見和未見的語言，羅馬化預訓練產生了最強的跨語言轉移，並且隨著規模的擴大，相對於文本的優勢也在擴大。IPA在大多數設置中優於文本，但仍落後於羅馬化。令人驚訝的是，對於在羅馬化數據上進行微調的文本預訓練模型，在已被基礎模型覆蓋的語言上會影響性能，只有在模型缺乏腳本覆蓋時才會有邊際幫助。我們的結果表明，對於跨越類型學上多樣化腳本的多語言模型，為了獲得最大的好處，羅馬化應被視為在預訓練階段應用的核心設計選擇，而不是事後的修正。
